title: Vowel-Consonant Score
summary: Given a string s made of lowercase English letters, spaces, and digits, count the vowels and consonants.
statement: Given a string s made of lowercase English letters, spaces, and digits, count the vowels and consonants. The score is the floor of the vowel count divided by the consonant count if there are any consonants; otherwise, the score is 0.
constraints: Count lowercase vowels and lowercase consonants in s; ignore spaces and digits.
Return zero when there are no consonants.
reference_solution:
def vowel_consonant_floor_score(s):
    vowels=sum(char in 'aeiou' for char in s)
    consonants=sum(char.isalpha() and char not in 'aeiou' for char in s)
    return vowels//consonants if consonants else 0
